Name: Why Not Jump In That Mine Shaft
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
Imagine that you are fighting in the skull cavern, and you find a mine shaft, but you want to dig some more valuable minerals, then you forgot the mine shaft and go downstairs via a stair. Do you feel annoyed somehow? Well, this mod can help you say goodbye to these circumstances!

This mod adds a confirmation prompt before taking the stairs down when a shaft exists; two indicators point at the nearest stair and shaft if available; and a configurable text prompter to show specific information. They can significantly improve your mining experience!

By default, the purple indicator points to the nearest shaft, the blue one points to the nearest stair, and the yellow-green one points to the calico status.

[b][color=#12ff31]For the best experience, I highly recommend using it with mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37716]Skull Cavern Floor Capping[/url].[/color][/b]

This mod supports i18n, and contributions are welcome! You can commit your translation on [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/tree/master/WhyNotJumpInThatMineShaft#translating-the-mods]Github[/url]. English is not my mother tongue, so for native English users, if you want to improve the current English translation, you can also come and help!

[color=#ef2320][b]Note that this mod cannot predict the stair and shaft![/b][/color]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Incompatible mods are not clear temporarily, if you find an incompatible mod, please report at [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿,

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

Please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿, please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.

想象这样一个情景，你正在骷髅洞穴中浴血奋战，然后你发现了一个竖井，但是你又想再挖一些矿在走，于是挖着挖着你忘记了这个竖井，然后从一个梯子处进入了下一层。你突然回想起来那个竖井，发出了尖锐的爆鸣声，而你和那个竖井，从此就像年少时错过的初恋，只能在无数个深夜里捶胸顿足……

所以要怎么办呢，赶紧下载这个 mod 吧！当地图上出现了一个竖井，而你仍准备从梯子处进入下一层时，本 mod 会提示你是否执意要走这个梯子（当然，真要走我也拦不住你）。此外，还添加了两个指示器指向最近的竖井和梯子，以及一个可配置的文字提示，提供更多的有效信息。

[b][color=#12ff31]强烈建议配合模组 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37716]Skull Cavern Floor Capping[/url] 食用！！[/color][/b]

蓝色的箭头将指向最近的梯子，紫色的箭头指向最近的竖井，黄绿色的箭头指向卡利科三花猫雕像。

[color=#ef2320][b]注意：本模组无法预测梯子和竖井的位置！[/b][/color]
